set.body:
After ordered reading AOIs/first-pass semantics, add the two small adapter cells for AOI dwell and first-pass time. Consume identical annotated fixation inputs and 72 ordered non-overlapping word AOIs; verify counts, durations, skips/regressions and invalid support independently. Split adapter implementations further before editing if this exceeds half a day.

Bounded adapter slice using docs/plans/PYMOVEMENTS_PERFORMANCE.md and the PM3.2 collector. Acceptance: source/data/config-bound raw receipts for all declared scales and modes; deliberate wrong-output and failed-process cases rejected; no budget relaxation after results. Run relevant correctness checks. Split before implementation if more than roughly half a day. This adapter alone cannot close PM3.
set.title: PM3.10 Measure AOI assignment/dwell and first-pass reading
